name: Doma Taihei
source:
Taihei is Umaru's older brother who works at a company in systems support. He is described as having a kind and methodical personality, but scolds Umaru when she acts lazy.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Himouto!_Umaru-chan]Wikipedia[/url]]
